subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should imported Claw cron declarations become a permanent Gateway-owned, shared-state lifecycle contract before this stacked feature is accepted?
rationale: The patch establishes new durable ownership and recovery semantics across imported packages, the CLI, shared state, and the Gateway; code review cannot choose that product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the ownership model
options.body: Accept Gateway-owned scheduler mutation with canonical shared-state registration and require complete reconciliation and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Defer cron lifecycle
options.body: Keep cron declarations read-only until the Claws RFC and foundational stack establish the permanent ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve the ownership model
recommendation.body: Accept Gateway-owned scheduler mutation with canonical shared-state registration and require complete reconciliation and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current declaration-key, owner-attribution, Gateway scope, and shared-state cron contract originates in the merged work they authored.
